posts.title: Dancing Stars Quilt Along Week 5 – Backing & Basting
posts.description: If you have lots of leftover scraps, throw them onto the back to add a creative touch to your quilt. That’s what I did for my Americana version. I do what’s called the “Puzzle Method” where I put the top on my design wall and then cover it up with leftover chunks of fabric until it’s enough. If I have smaller pieces of fabric, I’ll sew those together into larger segments first, and then make sure they aren’t around the edges since that will get trimmed off the most. If you are just finding this quilt along, be sure to grab a copy of the Dancing Stars pattern to follow along. Remember, you can sew at your own pace! posts.title: Dancing Stars Quilt Along Week 4 – Sewing the Quilt Top
posts.description: How is your Dancing Stars quilt going? Remember, during this quilt along you can sew at your own pace! This week we are sewing our blocks together to make the quilt top. I made 2 versions with a couple of tips for each. First of all, for my black & white version, I had mapped out all of the colors ahead of time so it was simple to sew the blocks and then arrange them in a pleasing order. I created a checker board around the blocks with every other square being light or dark. As you can see above, a couple of the grays could have gone either way, so I think that gives it a “not quite perfect” border layout which is what I was going for. For my Americana version, I sewed all the inner blocks, but waited to add the extra rectangles that spin the blocks until I was pleased with the color arrangmement. posts.title: Dancing Stars Quilt Along Week 3 – Making the Star Blocks
posts.description: We’ve gathered our fabrics and cut everything out, so this week we finally get to sew those pretty star blocks together. This is the part I love – seeing all the different fabric combinations turn into actual stars! If you are still cutting, no worries. You can work at your own pace and jump into the sewing whenever you are ready. Keep your Dancing Stars pattern handy and follow the block assembly steps there. Today I’m sharing a peek at how both of my versions came together. Click here to get the Dancing Stars Quilt Pattern – Digital PDF Click here to get the Dancing Stars Quilt Pattern – Printed Hardcopy Sewing My Americana Version with Riley Blake Batiks I started with my red, white and blue batiks from Riley Blake Designs. Last week I had all of my light and dark fabrics separated into stacks. Now I could start pairing them up and watching the star points take shape.
